_meta.title: Scotland: stop and search by ethnicity, by council area, 2018/19 - 2025/26
_meta.measures: Number of stop and searches Police Scotland carried out in each council area, by the ethnicity recorded for the person searched, and how many found something (positive). Compare a group's share of searches with its share of the council's population (Scotland's Census 2022).
_meta.source: Police Scotland, Stop and Search Data Publication (record-level CSV files '1b', one per fiscal year)
_meta.licence: Crown copyright police material: Open Government Licence; Scottish Police Authority material: reusable without formal permission if reproduced accurately with source identified
_meta.licence_quote: Crown copyright police material is made available under the Open Government Licence
_meta.licence_quote_2: can be copied or reproduced without formal permission, provided it is copied or reproduced accurately
_meta.licence_caveat: The data page carries no explicit licence; the Police Scotland guide says to direct enquiries about Police Scotland copyright material to Police Scotland first.
_meta.citation: Police Scotland (2026). Stop and Search Data Publication, 1 April 2018 - 30 June 2026.

_meta.keys: eth_<group>_searches / _positive = each detailed ethnicity exactly as Police Scotland records it; white / african_caribbean_black / asian / mixed / other / not_provided / not_recorded = broad groups built here from the detailed list (Census-style; 'other' = Arab and Other Ethnic Group); all_* = everyone.
notes: Each row in the source is one search of one person.
2019/20 CSV is padded with empty rows to Excel's limit; empty rows were dropped (41,651 records kept).
No rates: the source gives counts only.
Council names were spelled differently across years ('&' vs 'and'; 'Eilean Siar' vs 'Na h-Eileanan an Iar'); they were merged.
'(no council)' = records with no council in the source (kept, no outline).
